g.text: Walk over to the tall slide.
Pump until the chains go floppy.
Hop off while the swing is low.
Dig a hole all the way down.
Fill the bucket to the brim.
Brush the sand off and look up.
Pat the sand down and stand up.
Leave the tower and turn round.
Go and look at the steps.
Put a hand on the rail.
Sit at the top and look.
Sit on the grass a minute.
Let the big one go first.
Say it is my turn next.
Watch how they all do it.
Wait for the step to be empty.
Get up off the wet grass.
Put one foot on the first step.
Go up with Nan holding on.
Go all the way to the top.
Stop and look at the park.
Go down the little slide twice.
Let the yellow coat go again.
